places.name: The Aeries
places.text: Tall houses with landing-ledges in place of front doors, where Windperch's winged folk live. The town is the largest settlement of them outside the Aerialring.

places.name: The Open-Air Field
places.epithet: Before they ever approach the Dropway
places.text: The slope where young fliers are trained in open air before they are ever allowed near the Dropway above.

places.name: The Weather-Station
places.text: The chief of the ground weather-stations Windperch keeps for the Weave: vanes, gauges, and a reader on watch at every hour.

places.name: The Hard-Landing Distillery
places.epithet: Considered medicinal after a hard landing
places.text: Where Windperch distils its strong liquor, which is prescribed, poured and not argued with after a bad fall.

places.name: Landing Square
places.text: The town square, kept clear of awnings and washing-lines so that anyone can come down into it.

places.name: The Old Trail
places.text: South from Windperch past Gimorand along the foot of the western heights.
